name: Dear Prince, Sleep Well
source:
You -a little girl by the name of Evie- are on a mission to awaken a prince from a cursed slumber. Prepare yourself for the challenges that you will face on your quest and once you reach the end...the choice is yours.
[From [url=https://zodiacstories.itch.io/dear-prince-sleep-well] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你——一个名叫伊维的小女孩——肩负着将王子从被诅咒的沉睡中唤醒的使命。为你的任务中将面临的挑战做好准备，一旦到达终点……选择权就在你手中。
[来自[url=https://zodiacstories.itch.io/dear-prince-sleep-well] itch.io[/url]]
